file: 006 - In This World, People Can't See Colors Until They Touch Their SOULMATE - 4.3M.mp4

voices.who: narrator (also reads best friend's line at 0:33.6)
voices.first_words: In this world, you can't see colors until you touch your soulmate.
voices.sounds_like: ElevenLabs 'Adam'-style adult male storytime TTS (same as 009), ~90% sure
voices.delivery: sincere, earnest-storyteller, brisk, deadpan on the romantic-twist punchline
voices.timing_notes: Continuous ~1.2x pace with all breaths removed (zero silences across 34.4s); stretches 'vibrant COLOR' (0:29.5-0:30.2) before snapping 'instantly!' on the 0:30.3 R&B drop, and reads 'your tie is red' deadpan at 0:33.6-0:34.3 into the hard cut.

one_voice_plays_several_characters: yes — one male TTS narrator reads both the third-person romance story and the blond best friend's line ('your tie is red', 0:33.6-0:34.3) with no pitch, filter, or voice change.

music.description: wistful synthwave storytime loop with warm detuned synth pads and gentle high synth lead
music.how_it_follows_the_story: Plays gently under the grayscale world-building, proposal, and gray wedding hug (0:00.0-0:30.2) to sell an earnest tearjerker before hard-cutting on the twist.

music.description: sensual R&B / neo-soul slow-jam (Cmaj7-Dbmaj7-Ebmaj7 Rhodes chords, deep bass, rimshot groove)
music.how_it_follows_the_story: Drops in louder at 0:30.3 on 'instantly!' (+ Vine boom) as rainbow color erupts from touching his male best friend, flipping the wedding drama into a 'sus bromance' groove through 'your tie is red' (0:34.4).

sound_effects.sound: crisp opening whoosh and low transient hit
bright magical rising shimmer and fairy sparkle chime
subtle low desaturation thud / airy sweep
heavy sub-bass boom (-6.8 dB peak) on R&B drop

ambience: none — studio music beds and spot foley only
sync_with_picture: Every color shift has foley: filter whoosh drains color (0:00.7); sparkle chime bursts into color (0:03.8); low thud turns street gray (0:08.5); glint chime hits engagement ring rays (0:12.3); hopeful chime (0:17.4) is crushed by dull gray thud (0:18.7); shimmer swell hits rainbow arch (0:28.3); R&B groove + Vine boom slam at 0:30.3 before horrified Liam / glaring Sarah (0:31.0); final boom hits the friend's smirk on 'RED' (0:34.1).
faces_and_mouths: No lip-sync; R6 heads swap static 2D decals per shot: nervous sweat (0:02.0), blushing '^_^' hug (0:15.5), huge hopeful eyes (0:17.2), stumble panic (0:24.4), traumatized stare with squinting bride behind (0:31.0), and the best friend's static open-mouth seductive smirk (0:33.5).
comedic_or_emotional_timing: Plays 0:00.0-0:28.2 straight as a sincere soulmate tearjerker (wistful synthwave, hopeful chime at 0:17.4 crushed by 0:18.7 thud), then hijacks the genre at 0:30.3 with a Vine boom + 70 BPM R&B slow-jam and cuts zero frames after 'your tie is red' (0:34.4).
first_3_seconds: Punchy whoosh/hit at 0:00.1 (-8.1 dB peak), wistful synthwave pads, and brisk TTS ('In this world, you can't see colors until you touch your soulmate') as color drains to gray at 0:00.7 — instant high-concept hook.
ending: Hard-cuts mid-R&B groove at 0:34.4 (-10.1 dB RMS) right after 'your tie is red' and the 0:34.1 Vine boom, snapping cleanly into the 0:00.1 opening hit.
mix: Clean narrative mix (-14.1 LUFS, LRA 3.4 LU, -0.1 dBTP); midrange-focused (58.0% in 250 Hz-4 kHz) for 30s, then surges in sub-bass (-6.8 dB <110 Hz peak) at 0:30.3-0:34.4 on the R&B bassline and Vine booms.
why_the_sound_works: Earnest synthwave from 0:00.0 to 0:30.2 sells the emotional fake-out so the comedic twist blindsides viewers.
Color-state foley (sparkle chimes at 0:03.8/0:28.3 vs. dull sweeps at 0:08.5/0:18.7) makes color grading audible.
Hard-switching to a 70 BPM sensual R&B groove + Vine boom at 0:30.3 lands the bromance joke instantly.
Zero-breath narration and an immediate cut on 'your tie is red' (0:34.4) leave zero dead air.
unsure_about: Titles of the 0:00.0-0:30.2 synthwave loop (identical to 013) and 0:30.3-0:34.4 R&B groove (both left null).
